author: Marcel Schanz (mschanz)
modifications: Converted source FBX (0.01 scale, 90 deg rotation applied) and uniformly scaled to a 12 m nose-to-tail animal; feet placed on z=0 (scripts/assets/blender/tyrannosaurus_prep.py)

Rebuilt PBR materials from the source maps: base colour + normal kept (resized 4096->2048), roughness derived as 1 - Glossiness and packed into a 512 px ORM texture; LightingMap, SubSurface and internal AO maps unused; eye normal map dropped and eye colour map reduced to 256 px (size budget)

Authored a 28-bone deform armature (spine, neck, head, jaw, 6 tail bones, 2 legs x thigh/shin/foot/toes, 2 arms x 3) because the source is static; skinned with Blender automatic weights (scripts/assets/blender/tyrannosaurus_rig.py)

Lower jaw re-weighted by a mouth plane, then the jaw weight relaxed over the surface (12 smoothing passes) so the throat skin has no torn spikes; each tooth/claw/eye/tongue shell bound rigidly: teeth follow the jaw if they are below the mouth plane or rooted in jaw-weighted skin, otherwise the head; unweighted shells bound to the nearest bone; max 4 influences per vertex

Authored clips idle (4.0 s), walk (2.4 s, 1.2 m/s, toe tips planted via analytic 2-bone IK, 9 cm double-step body bob, tail counter-swing), roar (3.5 s) procedurally; every clip loops (last frame = first) (scripts/assets/blender/tyrannosaurus_anim.py)
Mouth: sculpt is posed gaping; clips close the jaw 31 degrees (closed mouth is the idle/walk pose)
Anatomy check at 1 m: hands show 2 clawed fingers with the palm facing inward (not pronated), arm about 0.7 m, horizontal posture, knees forward; no rest-pose change needed
Optimized with scripts/assets/optimize.mjs: high = full mesh, 2048 px KTX2; low = 35 % triangles, 1024 px KTX2; meshopt

author: wojciechmiedziocha
modifications: Converted the source OBJ (Y-up to Z-up) and uniformly scaled it to an 8 m nose-to-tail animal (about 3.2 m at the frill); feet placed on z=0, -Y forward (scripts/assets/blender/triceratops_prep.py)

Subdivided the 12,560-triangle sculpt once (Catmull-Clark, UVs kept, smooth shading) to 50,472 triangles (65,294 after the local snout subdivision below, as shipped in the high GLB) so horn bases, eye socket and beak do not facet at 1 m; surface detail stays in the baked normal map

Head clean-up (prep stage): one extra local subdivision of the snout; Laplacian relaxing of the beak outline and of the row of scale bumps above the mouth line (geometry only); a 1-2 cm strip (width measured in 3D per texel, feathered over 1-2 texels) along the mouth line (the lower rostral margin) painted plain in the base colour (tooth outlines blurred out from the surrounding skin) and flattened in the normal map, with the original skin texture and normals kept everywhere else on the snout and cheek; the pale brow/nasal horn bases flared 2.5 cm along their normals (fading over 0.16 m), the skin collar lip pulled up to half-way towards each shaft within 3 cm and relaxed so the shafts fill the collar, and the normal map flattened over the collar ring to remove pits and specular slivers (scripts/assets/blender/triceratops_prep.py)

Rebuilt the PBR material from the source maps: base colour + normal resized 4096->2048, roughness (source roughness map) packed into a 1024 px ORM texture (baked AO in R is carried but unused by the glTF material); specular, metallic and internal ground-AO maps dropped

Authored a 29-bone deform armature (spine, neck, head, jaw, 6 tail bones, 2 hind legs x thigh/shin/foot/toes, 2 forelimbs x upper/lower/hand/fingers) because the source is static; skinned with Blender automatic weights (scripts/assets/blender/triceratops_rig.py)

Beak/lower jaw re-weighted by a mouth-line plane and relaxed over the surface (4 smoothing passes) so the beak can chew without tearing the lip; weights limited to 4 influences per vertex and normalised

Authored clips idle (4.0 s), walk (2.2 s, four-beat lateral sequence, 0.78 m/s, toe tips planted via analytic 2-bone IK, body bob and roll, tail counter-swing) and eat (5.0 s, head lowered to the ground, three beak chomps up to 12 degrees) procedurally; every clip loops (last frame = first) (scripts/assets/blender/triceratops_anim.py)
Anatomy check at 1 m: three facial horns (brow pair + nose), solid frill with no holes, forelimbs held under the body (not sprawled), hind knees forward; no rest-pose change needed
Optimized with scripts/assets/optimize.mjs: high = full mesh, 2048 px KTX2; low = 35 % triangles, 1024 px KTX2; meshopt

author: seirogan
modifications: Imported source FBX (rigged, 489,096 faces); baked its rest pose and discarded the source armature, its weights and its only clip 'Armature|paki' (a travelling leap, not an idle or walk); uniformly scaled to a 4.5 m nose-to-tail animal (factor 0.218), feet on z=0 (scripts/assets/blender/pachycephalosaurus_prep.py)

Decimated 489k -> 136,946 triangles with Blender collapse decimation (ratio 0.28; head, dome, nodes and limbs weighted to keep more triangles; UVs kept), smooth shading; the source normal map carries the fine detail
Rebuilt one PBR material from the source maps: base colour + tangent normal map, both resized 4096 -> 2048 px; the source ships no roughness map so roughness is a constant 0.75

Authored a 27-bone armature (26 deform bones) (spine, neck, head, 6 tail bones, 2 legs x thigh/shin/foot/toes, 2 arms x 3) because the source clip and rig are unusable; joints placed from orthographic views; skinned with Blender automatic weights, separate shells bound rigidly, max 4 influences per vertex; no jaw bone (mouth stays closed, so no jaw or throat tearing is possible) (scripts/assets/blender/pachycephalosaurus_rig.py)

Authored clips idle (4.0 s breathing, weight shift, small head and tail drift) and walk (1.75 s, 0.7 m/s, toe tips planted via analytic 2-bone IK, 6 cm double-step body bob, stiff tail counter-swing) procedurally at 24 fps; every clip loops (last key = first) (scripts/assets/blender/pachycephalosaurus_anim.py)

Local texture repair (scripts/assets/blender/pachycephalosaurus_texfix.py): belly (midline, anterior, posterior, groin; left side moved to its own atlas texels so it is not a mirror), inner thigh, metatarsus seam and whole brow lobe re-projected from healthy scale texture (colour + normal) with weighted falloff, no blur, UVs untouched; walk clip toe contact locked to the floor from touchdown (frame-checked); the rest pose is kept as in the source (standing, both feet flat on the ground, dome with bony nodes, 3 toes per foot visible); no re-pose needed. Source texture left untouched (no blur, no flattening)
Optimized with scripts/assets/optimize.mjs: high = full decimated mesh, 2048 px KTX2; low = 35 % of high triangles, 1024 px KTX2; meshopt
